name: boostpipeline.com
description: Static site. style.css and fonts/ are committed build output; Cloudflare Pages needs no build step.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:fonts
scripts.build:fonts: mkdir -p fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans/files/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-wght-normal.woff2 fonts/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/LICENSE fonts/LICENSE-inter.txt && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans/LICENSE fonts/LICENSE-plus-jakarta-sans.txt
